name: manual_8c6d41
claim: For prepared event verification, resolve only the current event key inside the write lock and retain complete trust sampling at preparation and publication boundaries; do not introduce N-times-K resolver work.

decisions.notes: C6 independent review reproduced 256 resolver reads for 16 events and 16 keys; the regression now requires 16 per-event reads.

rationale: C6 independent review reproduced 256 resolver reads for 16 events and 16 keys; the regression now requires 16 per-event reads.
